title: SS27 Toddler Boys' Trim Market Strategy
summary: Safety-first trims are the commercial choice for toddler boys.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- In Italy, childrenswear exports fell 9.3% and domestic sales 2.6% in 2025 (Confindustria Moda via Fortune Italia)<sup>[1]</sup>
- Newer lines emphasise breathability, quick drying and comfort; childrenswear is moving toward functionality, material quality and durability<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Build, test, sell through
sections.body:
| Action | Trims |
|---|---|
| Build | Snaps, printed labels, embroidery |
| Test | Appliqué |
| Avoid | Beads, sequins, shells |

design_implications:
- Avoid small parts.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.

sources.title: Pitti, la moda bambino punta su sostenibilita e protezione UV: cosi i brand preparano l'estate 2027
